title: Blackberry and Resinous Gratin Italiano
description: A sweet and savory Italian dessert featuring blackberries and resinous notes, topped with a rich gratin.
instructions: Mix the almond flour, sugar, and 1/4 cup of the unsalted butter until crumbly.
Press the mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish.
Arrange the blackberries in a single layer.
Drizzle the resinous honey over the blackberries.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, vanilla extract, and the remaining 1/4 cup of unsalted butter.
Pour the egg mixture over the blackberries.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the fruit is bubbly.
Serve warm, topped with additional blackberries if desired.
